arguments.value: Richard Ernest Myers II was born in Kingston, Jamaica in 1967. He has served as a judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of North Carolina since his confirmation and commission in December 2019, and has been chief judge since 2021. He earned a B.A. and M.A. from the University of North Carolina Wilmington and a J.D. from the University of North Carolina School of Law. Earlier in his career, he clerked for Judge David B. Sentelle on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, practiced privately in Los Angeles, served as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California and the Eastern District of North Carolina, and taught at the University of North Carolina School of Law, where he held several academic and administrative positions.
